filename: # metadata.csv — Image attribution and tracking record
# Fill in ONE ROW PER IMAGE at download time. Reconstructing this later is painful.
# Keep this file even if you never publish the dataset — it protects you legally
# and makes it possible to remove images if a license changes or is disputed.
# COLUMN GUIDE
# filename       : Exact filename as stored in data/images/<split>/
#                  e.g.  tiger_001.jpg
# species        : Your class label (must match data/dataset.yaml names exactly)
#                  e.g.  nilgiri_tahr | lion_tailed_macaque | nilgiri_langur | malabar_civet
#                        gaur | bengal_tiger | sloth_bear | asian_elephant | nilgiri_marten
#                        anaimalai_flying_frog
# scientific_name: Full binomial
# source_site    : Where you found it: iNaturalist | Wikimedia Commons | GBIF | other
# source_url     : Direct URL to the observation or file page (not the image file itself)
#                  e.g.  https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/12345678
#                        https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Example.jpg
# observation_id : Numeric ID from iNaturalist / GBIF (leave blank for Wikimedia)
#                  Used for grouping burst shots to the same split (anti-leakage)
# photographer   : Attribution name as shown on the source page
# license        : SPDX identifier: CC0-1.0 | CC-BY-4.0 | CC-BY-SA-4.0 | CC-BY-NC-4.0
#                  Use exactly the identifier from the source page.
#                  If unclear → skip the image.
# attribution_text: Full attribution string to use if you display or publish:
#                  e.g.  "Nilgiri Tahr" by Jane Doe (iNaturalist obs. 12345678)
# date_downloaded: ISO-8601 date  e.g.  2024-10-15
# split          : train | val | test | unassigned
#                  Assign at SPLIT TIME (after grouping by observation_id).
#                  Set to "unassigned" while collecting; update before training.
# notes          : Anything worth recording: image quality
#                  angle
# EXAMPLE ROWS:
# nilgiri_tahr_0001.jpg
attribution_text: Nilgiri Tahr by Jane Doe (iNat obs. 99000001) CC BY 4.0
